name: yalisp
description: The YALisp monorepo and landing page.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @yalisp/site-content && npm run build --workspace @yalisp/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @yalisp/site-content && npm run dev --workspace @yalisp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @yalisp/site-content && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
